name: Oddendale Stone Circle

quotes.quote: hamlet in Cumbria, England, UK
Oddendale has a stone circle nearby, (grid reference NY59201290)

why: The stone circle record carries Q7077485 / enwiki Oddendale, which is the item and article of the hamlet (the container), not of the circle; the article says the hamlet 'has a stone circle nearby'. Its point is also the hamlet's point (54.5141, -2.6280), about 500 m NE of the circle at NY59201291 (54.509846N, 2.631652W per the Megalithic Portal), which should be repaired with the link.

name: Dilmun Burial Mounds - Dar Kulaib Burial Mound Field

quotes.quote: are a UNESCO World Heritage Site comprising necropolis areas on the main island of Bahrain
Madinat Hamad 3 Burial Mound Field (Dar Kulayb)

why: The record is the Dar Kulaib (Madinat Hamad 3) Burial Mound Field by name and text, another component of the serial property, with its own item Q65954051 (WHS ID 1542-020) at 26.075, 50.5056. It carries the container item Q5276996. Its point (26.1473, 50.5083) lies in the A'ali West field, about 8 km north of Dar Kulaib, so it is misplaced, not a second record of A'ali West: name, text and item all name a different field. Link and point to be repaired elsewhere.

name: Dilmun Burial Mounds - A'ali West Burial Mound Field

quotes.quote: are a UNESCO World Heritage Site comprising necropolis areas on the main island of Bahrain
A’ali West Burial Mound Field

why: The record is the A'ali West Burial Mound Field, one of the 21 component sites of the serial World Heritage property; it carries Q5276996 / enwiki Dilmun Burial Mounds, the item of the whole property (the container). The component has its own item Q65954033 (WHS ID 1542-003, 26.1461, 50.5078), which matches this record's point within about 100 m. Not a duplicate of the Dar Kulaib record: a different component field.

name: Taula

quotes.quote: is a Stonehenge-esque stone monument found on the Balearic island of Menorca

why: Q940097 / enwiki 'Taula' names the monument type found across Menorca (the article lists over 30 taula sites), not one site; this record is a type entry placed at one point (39.9668, 4.0834) that is 18.7 km from Trepuco. It is not the same site as Trepuco, so no merge; its link (and which taula it means) must be repaired.

name: Talaiot y Taula de Trepucó

quotes.quote: Examples include those at Torre Trencada, Talatí de Dalt, Torrellissá Nou, Trepucó

why: The Talayotic settlement of Trepuco near Mahon is one example of a taula site; the record carries Q940097 / 'Taula', the item of the monument type, instead of Trepuco's own item (Wikidata Q2451783 'Trepuco'). 18.7 km from the 'Taula' record: a different place, no merge.

name: Yarrows Broch

quotes.quote: The Iron Age is the final epoch of the three-age system of technology after the Copper Age and Bronze Age

why: Not a duplicate: Yarrows Broch (Caithness) and Dun Cuier (Barra, Outer Hebrides) are two different Iron Age monuments 297,868 m apart, asked together only because both carry the enwiki article 'Iron Age'. That article names a period of prehistory (a type), not this broch, so the record's Wikipedia link is wrong. Its Wikidata item Q747937 is the broch's own (Wikidata en label 'Broch of Yarrows', 'tower in Highland, Scotland, UK'; nl.wikipedia 'Broch of Yarrows'), which the link repair can follow.

name: Dun Cuier

quotes.quote: The Iron Age is the final epoch of the three-age system of technology after the Copper Age and Bronze Age

why: Not a duplicate of Yarrows Broch (297,868 m away, a different monument on another island group). Its enwiki article 'Iron Age' names a period of prehistory, not Dun Cuier, so the record's Wikipedia link is wrong. Its Wikidata item Q1265207 is the site's own (Wikidata en label 'Dun Cuier', 'tower in Outer Hebrides, Scotland, UK'; de.wikipedia 'Dun Cuier'), which the link repair can follow.

name: Estipeon

quotes.quote: History is the systematic study of the past, focusing primarily on the human past.

why: The record carries enwiki 'History', the article on the academic discipline, not the ancient settlement Astibo/Estipeon at Stip (its Wikidata item Q4810863 'Astibo' with enwiki 'Astibo' is the right one). The two records are 2,588,698 m apart and unrelated: a Paeonian/Roman town in North Macedonia and a Neolithic cairn in Orkney.

name: Crantit Chambered Cairn

quotes.quote: History is the systematic study of the past, focusing primarily on the human past.

why: The record carries enwiki 'History', the article on the academic discipline, not the Crantit chambered cairn near Kirkwall (its Wikidata item Q1138920 'Crantit', dewiki 'Crantit Cairn', is the right one and has no English article). Unrelated to Estipeon, 2,588,698 m away.

name: Mortuary Temple of Seti I

quotes.quote: Mortuary temples (or funerary temples) were temples that were erected adjacent to, or in the vicinity of, royal tombs in Ancient Egypt.

why: Q927825 / enwiki 'Mortuary temple' is the building type, not the Mortuary Temple of Seti I at Qurna. The three temples are different monuments 81 to 494 km apart (Qurna, Hawara, Giza), so nothing merges.

name: Mortuary Temple of Hawara

quotes.quote: Mortuary temples (or funerary temples) were temples that were erected adjacent to, or in the vicinity of, royal tombs in Ancient Egypt.

why: Q927825 / enwiki 'Mortuary temple' is the building type, not the mortuary temple (the Labyrinth) of Amenemhat III's pyramid at Hawara. It is a separate monument, 429 km from Qurna and 82 km from Giza.

name: Mortuary Temple of Khufu

quotes.quote: Mortuary temples (or funerary temples) were temples that were erected adjacent to, or in the vicinity of, royal tombs in Ancient Egypt.

why: Q927825 / enwiki 'Mortuary temple' is the building type, not the mortuary temple of Khufu at the Great Pyramid of Giza. It is a separate monument from the Seti I and Hawara temples.

name: Κourion Ancient Amphitheatre

quotes.quote: Theatre or theater is a collaborative form of performing art that uses live performers

why: The theatre of Kourion (Cyprus) is its own site, 44.6 km from the Paphos theatre and 1,721 km from Salona; it is clustered only because it carries enwiki 'Theatre', the article on the performing art (a type), not on this monument. Its own article is the ru.wikipedia 'Театр в Курионе'; the Wikidata item Q4453457 is not in question here.

name: Amfiteatar Salona

quotes.quote: Theatre or theater is a collaborative form of performing art that uses live performers

why: The Roman amphitheatre of Salona (Solin, Croatia) is its own site, about 1,700 km from both Cyprus theatres; its enwiki link 'Theatre' is the type article on the performing art, not this amphitheatre (own article: hr.wikipedia 'Amfiteatar u Saloni', item Q2844418).

name: Hellenistic-Roman Theatre

quotes.quote: Theatre or theater is a collaborative form of performing art that uses live performers

why: The ancient theatre of Nea Paphos (Cyprus) is its own site, 44.6 km from Kourion; its enwiki link 'Theatre' is the type article on the performing art, not this monument (item Q70772384 not in question here).

name: First Pylon

quotes.quote: The Precinct of Amun-Re is an Ancient Egyptian temple precinct, or sacred enclosure, dedicated to Amun-Re
It contains numerous structures and monuments.

why: Not a duplicate of the Column of Taharqa: the First Pylon is the unfinished 30th-Dynasty entrance gateway of the Temple of Amun at Karnak, the column the last standing column of Taharqa's kiosk in the court behind it (121 m apart, two different monuments). The records were grouped only because both carry enwiki 'Precinct of Amun-Re', which names the whole 25 ha temple precinct (the container), not the pylon; the pylon has only a section there. Its Wikidata item Q124890504 ('First Pylon', unfinished pylon of Nectanebo I in Karnak) is its own and correct; only the article link needs repair.

name: Column of Taharqa

quotes.quote: In the center of this first court are the ruins of the kiosk of Taharqa (690-664 B.C.E.),
Only one column remains in place, bearing inscriptions by Taharqa, Psamtik II and Ptolemy IV Philopator.

why: Not a duplicate of the First Pylon: the Column of Taharqa is the one standing column of the kiosk of Taharqa in the centre of the first court of Karnak, behind the First Pylon (121 m apart). Its enwiki 'Precinct of Amun-Re' names the whole temple precinct (the container), where the kiosk has only a short section; its Wikidata item Q124887901 ('Column of Taharqa') is its own and correct, only the article link needs repair.

name: Pergamon Amfitiyatrosu

quotes.quote: Roman amphitheatre in Bergama, Turkey
a huge forum and an amphitheatre were constructed

why: The Roman amphitheatre of Pergamon carries Q18986 and enwiki 'Pergamon', the item and article of the whole city, which is its container. Its own item is Q29002436, labelled 'Pergamon amphitheatre' (Turkish label 'Pergamon Amfitiyatrosu', the record's name), with coordinates 39.126, 27.174 that match this record's point and P361 = Q18986. It is a component of the city record, 1,128 m away, never a duplicate. The link should be repaired to Q29002436, and the record could then be linked to the Pergamon record as its parent.

name: Butrint Ancient Theatre

quotes.quote: By the 4th century BC it had grown in importance and included a theatre, a sanctuary dedicated to Asclepius and an agora.

why: The record is the ancient theatre of Butrint (its description is about the 3rd-century BC theatre only), but its Wikidata item Q188694 and its article 'Butrint' name the whole city, the container; even its English names 'Bouthroton; Mint of Buthrotum' come from the city's item. The link must be repaired to the theatre's own item. It is not a duplicate of Butrint (14 m apart because the theatre lies within the city); once relinked it is a component of Butrint (17c94d52).

name: Idaean Cave

quotes.quote: is an ancient Minoan sacred cave in the Lasithi plateau in the Lasithi district of eastern Crete
liegt in 1495 Metern Höhe am westlichen Rand der Nida-Hochebene in Zentralkreta

why: The Idaean Cave lies on Mount Ida (Psiloritis, Nida plateau, central Crete), 56 km from the Psychro Cave on the Lasithi plateau; two different caves. Its Wikidata item Q935991 is right (Idaean Cave, dewiki Idäische Grotte), but its enwiki link 'Psychro Cave' names the other cave (Q935991's enwiki sitelink 'Cave of Zeus' is a redirect).

name: Naveta Biniac

quotes.quote: A naveta (also known as funerary naveta or burial naveta) is a form of megalithic chamber tomb unique to the Balearic island of Menorca.
Some examples of this type of building include Biniac-l'Argentina, Torrellisar, and others.

why: Q1234523 / enwiki 'Naveta' is the article and item of the monument TYPE (Wikidata: instance of a type, subclass of chamber tomb, no coordinates), not of the Biniac naveta (Biniac-l'Argentina near Alaior), which the article names only as one example of the type. The record is a real site; its link needs its own item. The two records are 9,218 m apart and are two different points, so no merge.

name: Naveta

quotes.quote: A naveta (also known as funerary naveta or burial naveta) is a form of megalithic chamber tomb unique to the Balearic island of Menorca.

why: This record is named after the type and its description is the type article (navetas in general, Naveta d'Es Tudons as the largest example), yet it sits on one point in central Menorca, 9.2 km from Naveta Biniac. Q1234523 names the monument type, not any one site at this point, so the link does not name a site; it is not the same site as Naveta Biniac and nothing is merged.
